summary: PHILEON pre-launch CX audit (READ-ONLY, no code/DB/Stripe/email mutations). Verified locked invariants, exercised homepage → PDP → cart → checkout journey (desktop + mobile), rendered transactional email builders with synthetic order, and crawled key routes. Locked invariants intact: shipping CA=0/US=3500/T1=6500/T2=9500 cents (verified via /api/checkout/shipping-quote for CA,US,GB,FR,JP,AU,AE; IN/XX correctly rejected as UNSUPPORTED_DESTINATION); SIGNATURE_REQUIRED_ABOVE_USD_CENTS=50000 in services/shipping_zones.py; STRIPE_MODE=test in backend/.env; PHILEON_BEHAVIORAL_LIVE unset; historical order PHI-20260901-4CBC5C present in db.orders_v2 with payment_status='paid', currency='CAD', untouched. Catalog size: PRICING_ENGINE_CATALOG=47 + FIXED_PRODUCTS=24, ALL_SLUGS=73 (audit statement '84' does not match current source of truth — flag for owner). Homepage, PDP (la-marva), Add-to-Cart, /checkout order-summary + email + shipping-destination selector all functional. Currency selector USD→GBP renders 'Approx' localized line on PDP. Contact page loads with 6 form inputs. Mobile 390×844: no horizontal overflow on homepage, sticky Add-to-Cart reachable after scroll, hamburger opens editorial nav (LADIES FIRST / GENTLEMAN'S CLUB / THE COLLECTIVE / INSPIRATION VAULT / CONTACT). Order-status route /orders/:orderNumber/status is registered. Email builders return proper subject with order number, product_name + variant, presentment currency (when order['presentment'] sub-dict is populated), no Stripe/DB/webhook leaks. Two email defects found (size dropped from line items; customer paid email shows 'Canonical reference: $X USD' when presentment differs — audit requires canonical USD to appear in internal alert only). Three routing defects (blank body on /cart, /rings, and any unknown URL — no catch-all 404 route registered in App.js).

minor.issue: Catalog size PRICING_ENGINE_CATALOG(47) + FIXED_PRODUCTS(24) = 71 slugs; ALL_SLUGS=73 (adds 'cresta-nera','her-eternal-reign'). Audit prompt asserts locked catalog=84. Confirm with owner whether 84 counts SKUs/variants (tiers × metals × sizes) rather than product slugs.

Returns [] (empty). All product data lives in services/pricing_engine_catalog.py + FIXED_PRODUCTS, so this endpoint is effectively dead. Consider removing or wiring to source-of-truth to avoid confusion.

ui_bugs.issue: No route defined for /cart (only /checkout, /checkout/success, /checkout/cancel exist). Checkout.jsx line 198 redirects empty carts to /cart via navigate('/cart'), and PDPs/checkout header include a 'RETURN TO CART' link pointing to /cart. Result: users land on a blank white body with no content and no error. This is a user-visible dead-end.

No catch-all `path="*"` NotFound route registered. Any unknown URL (e.g. /rings, /men, /women, /search, typos) renders an EMPTY body with only the persistent header/footer. React-Router emits console.warning 'No routes matched location'. Users see a blank page instead of a 404.

Audit prompt referenced menu entries 'Men/Women/Rings/Pendants/Earrings/Fine Jewelry'. Actual PHILEON header uses editorial names: LADIES FIRST, GENTLEMAN'S CLUB, THE COLLECTIVE, THE INSPIRATION VAULT, CONTACT. Not a defect if intentional — confirm nomenclature is on-brand and matches marketing copy.

integration_issues.issue: services/order_emails._items_html and _items_text render {product_name, variant, quantity, unit_amount_cents} but DROP order['items'][*]['size']. Audit requires product/variant/size present in customer paid + shipment emails. Fix: include `size` (e.g., 'US 7', 'EU 54') on a third line under variant.

integration_issues.flow: Transactional email — canonical USD leak to customer
integration_issues.issue:
build_customer_paid_email appends '

Canonical reference: $X.XX USD

' (line ~200-206) whenever presentment currency differs from canonical. Audit requires: 'canonical USD context in the internal alert only (not customer-visible)'. This line IS customer-visible and violates the trust boundary. Remove from customer paid email; keep only in build_internal_paid_notification.

issues: Console spammed with repeating 'Error fetching metal prices: TypeError: Failed to fetch' and 'Market price fetch failed, using cached/fallback' every few seconds. Root cause: window.fetch is patched by Emergent asset script and third-party metal-price endpoint fails CORS/preflight. Cosmetic only (fallback values render), but pollutes DevTools and would hurt any Sentry/observability signal-to-noise post-launch. Consider swallowing the error at first failure and backing off.
Metal price ticker at top of viewport competes visually with 'PHILEON' logo mark and the black bg makes the yellow ticker rows very high-contrast — verify with owner this is intentional.

action_items: P0 · Register a /cart route in frontend/src/App.js OR change Checkout.jsx redirect target (line 198) + 'RETURN TO CART' link target to a valid route. Currently users hit a blank page.
P1 · Add catch-all `<Route path='*' element={<NotFoundPage/>} />` so /rings, /men, /women, /search and typos render a proper 404 instead of a blank body.
P1 · services/order_emails.py: include item['size'] in _items_html and _items_text output. Audit requires size in customer paid + shipment emails.

P1 · services/order_emails.py: remove the customer-facing 'Canonical reference: $X USD' block from build_customer_paid_email; retain canonical USD context only in build_internal_paid_notification per PHILEON trust-boundary rule.
P2 · Reconcile audit statement 'locked catalog=84' with actual ALL_SLUGS=73 in services/pricing_engine_catalog.py (owner confirmation — may be a variant count vs. slug count).
P2 · GET /api/products returns [] since DB is unused; either remove endpoint or wire to source-of-truth catalog to prevent confusion.
P2 · Silence repeating 'metal prices Failed to fetch' console errors — back off after N failures.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/App.js is missing a NotFound / catch-all route — a fundamental SPA correctness gap. Any typo or removed slug degrades to a silent blank page.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.jsx line 198 redirects empty carts to /cart, a route that is not registered. This is a broken contract between the checkout page and the router.

services/order_emails._items_html / _items_text hardcode product_name + variant + qty and silently drop `size`, `sku`, and any per-item metadata. Consider passing the entire item dict to a template function so newly-added fields (size, engraving text, karat spot lock) are picked up.

services/order_emails.build_customer_paid_email emits customer-visible 'Canonical reference: $X USD' when presentment differs — violates the documented trust-boundary rule that canonical USD is internal-only.

backend/.env exposes PHILEON_ORDER_STATUS_URL_BASE=<preview URL> — confirm this is swapped to the production https://getyourphileon.com origin before DNS cut-over, otherwise VIEW ORDER STATUS deep-links in real customer emails will point at the preview environment.
backend GET /api/products returns [] because the catalog lives in a Python module rather than db.products — dead endpoint should be removed or wired up.

success_rate.backend: Locked invariants 100% (5/5): shipping rates, signature threshold, Stripe mode, behavioral live flag, historical order. Email builders 60% (subject/product/variant/presentment/no-leak/status-link/concierge sender pass; size + canonical-USD-privacy fail).
success_rate.frontend: Homepage/PDP/ATC/Checkout core flow renders. 3 routing gaps (/cart, catch-all, unknown routes) render blank pages.

test_credentials: Not required — audit was read-only. Admin JWT available via `python -c 'from server import create_token; print(create_token("admin"))'` in /app/backend if follow-up needs admin surface.
seed_data_creation: None — no writes performed. Add-to-Cart only mutated browser localStorage (playwright session).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This was a READ-ONLY audit — no code, tests, .env, or DB state was modified. Historical order PHI-20260901-4CBC5C confirmed present and untouched (currency=CAD, payment_status=paid). If E1 addresses the P0 (/cart route) + P1 (catch-all, email size, email canonical-USD leak) fixes, next agent should (1) verify Checkout.jsx redirect no longer lands on blank page, (2) render build_customer_paid_email again with the synthetic order in this report and confirm both 'US 7' appears and 'Canonical reference' does NOT, (3) crawl /rings, /men, /women, /search, /nonexistent and confirm a NotFound page renders. Do NOT trigger a real Stripe payment or send real emails — always use the builder functions with synthetic dicts. Full curl-verified shipping-quote responses for CA/US/GB/JP/FR/AU/AE/IN in this iteration's logs.
rca of the issue: P0 /cart blank page: Checkout.jsx was written assuming a /cart route exists (navigate('/cart') on empty-cart guard and 'RETURN TO CART' anchor), but App.js was never updated with the corresponding <Route path='/cart'>. Fix: add the route (likely importing an existing CartPage component or creating a minimal one that reuses CartDrawer's item-list rendering) — single-line addition in App.js if a cart page component already exists. P1 email size drop: _items_html/_items_text signature only reads product_name+variant+quantity+unit_amount_cents fields — extend to append `size` when present. P1 canonical USD customer leak: the `canonical_reference` string is unconditionally injected into the customer HTML/text when paid.is_presentment is True — move that block to build_internal_paid_notification only.
